decisions.reason: The medical examination light builds on established competencies and serves the institutional customer base, and with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations, slack from an expanding firm allows it to be carried.
The explosion-proof luminaire line extends the core industrial business in a growing industry with strong R&D support, so it likely meets aspirations and gives no trigger for problemistic search.
The pendant office luminaire sits close to the established offer and uses existing engineering and distribution, so absent signs of underperformance it stays in the portfolio.
The premium pendant line is close to the core offer and fits the firm's push toward energy-efficient LED solutions, and the firm's expansion provides slack to carry it while its results mature.
